Crimson Wool Coat by the Car
Rights check
Source: 24603.jpg
Confident, bold, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The red coat should be the dominant color; keep the
backdrop muted.
- Add 'shallow depth of field' to separate her from the car.

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
windswept dark brown hair stands
beside a dark car in cool daylight. She
wears a full-length red wool wrap coat
with a stand collar, a row of gold buttons
at the shoulder, and a self-tie belt. She
holds a black leather top-handle bag
with gold hardware and wears black
gloves. Her expression is serious, and
her gaze is steady. Crisp, natural light, a
rich palette of crimson, charcoal, and
gold. Confident and polished, in the style
of a winter fashion editorial.
